title: PracticePay Returned-Payment Fees and the Customer's FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit
content:
**Rule.** The FlexLine share of a PracticePay Patient Financing returned-payment fee reads every FlexLine the customer has held: when the customer holds an active FlexLine and no late fee and no returned payment were posted on any of the customer's FlexLines within the last 12 months, the share is 0.95; when the customer holds an active FlexLine and a returned payment but no late fee was posted on any of them within the last 12 months, the share is 0.98; in every other case the share is 1; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the assessment date, a month being whole once the assessment date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

| Active FlexLine held | FlexLine entries, last 12 months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 0.95 |
| yes | returned payment only | 0.98 |
| yes | a late fee | 1 |
| no | anything | 1 |

The lines read are all of the customer's FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit; a line is an active FlexLine when its status on Larkspur's records is active.
